checks.ref:
command:change=$(find openspec/changes -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name archive)
review="$change/review-code.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-code stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: R2 Fix cites the wrong precedent: it says to use 'the form already used at packages/client/src/app/ViewErrorBoundary.tsx:22', but that line is `// Stryker disable next-line ObjectLiteral: equivalent — a missing flag is falsy too` (one line, one mutator, an equivalent mutant). The fix instead puts a block-wide `// Stryker disable all` over mutants that change behaviour and are only untested. That is a different form and goes against .claude/rules/tdd-workflow.md ('each survivor indicates a missed scenario or a weak assertion. Write additional tests to kill survived mutants'). If suppression is kept, the reason must say the mutants are untested by design (D8), not equivalent.

R2 Fix region is too wide and its Fix risk leaves this out: disabling from the useEffect at CalendarDialog.tsx:54 to after handleKeyDown at :72 also covers handleOpenChange at :61-64 (`if (isNowOpen) setFocusedIsoDate(dateBar.isoDate); setIsOpen(isNowOpen);`), whose mutants CalendarDialog.test.tsx already kills with clicks. The fix should cover only the uncovered lines (:57 and :66-71), or the Fix risk must say that killed mutants are dropped too.
R2 Fix's expected result '49 of 50 = 98% expected' is wrong: the proposed region also removes killed mutants on :55-64, so the killed count would no longer be 49. Recompute it, or drop the claim.
